outside of holiday peaks.

Detailed Description.   This business is one of the longest-running digital

asset libraries on the internet. With over 20 years of history and a collection

of more than 20 million images, illustrations, animations, and vectors, the site

offers subscribers unlimited access for a flat annual fee, generating

predictable recurring revenue.

What sets the business apart from competitors is its entrenched position in the

K–12 education market. A dedicated school-safe version is whitelisted on school

and library firewalls, integrated with single-sign-on tools common for

educational institutions, and carries approved vendor status on school software

lists. Approximately 30% of revenue comes from multi-seat accounts, primarily

from schools, libraries, and districts.

A buyer has the opportunity to acquire a premium domain (among other assets)

with institutional credibility, though the business has been neglected for the

past few years. The subscriber base has declined due to underinvestment, and the

site currently receives substantial search traffic that is not being effectively

converted into paying customers.

The most immediate growth opportunity is to improve the sign-up flow and

conversion rate, which should capture more paying customers without spending

more on acquisition. Beyond that, a focused push into district-level licensing,

a revamped SEO strategy that leverages the site's existing domain authority,

paid advertising (which has never been attempted), and AI-assisted collection

expansion all represent untapped potential.

The sellers spend about 6 hours per week on the business and have shifted their

focus to other ventures. Most day-to-day operations are handled by two

experienced contractors, leaving plenty of time for a new owner to focus on

growth. If you have experience in EdTech, digital marketing, or managing online

communities, this business offers a recognized brand with real competitive moats

that has been waiting for someone to give it the attention it deserves.

often within days of listing. Inquire now to get a leg up on other buyers.

Brand Legacy of Over 20 Years   Strong brand recognition and trust among

educators, small businesses, and creative professionals stem from the business’s

legacy of more than two decades.

Massive Content Library   The content library includes over 20 million images,

illustrations, animations, and vectors spanning virtually every category, plus

IP rights to approximately 35,000 original assets.

Recurring Revenue   Annual subscriptions deliver predictable, recurring revenue

with strong retention among loyal, long-term users.

Zero Paid Marketing   The sellers have never invested in paid advertising,

leaving an entirely unexplored channel for a buyer with digital marketing

experience.

Quick Transition   All recurring technical tasks are documented, and a new owner

with experience managing web properties could be fully operational in less than

a month.

Premium Domains   The core domain is nearly 30 years old, and the sale also

includes another long-standing domain that dates back to 1998.

https://quietlight.com   September 4th, 2026 Listing Alert.

 

SaaS & Software   2-Year-Old FinTech SaaS | 40 Customers | $33K SDE  

 

Financial Quickview.

Want to sign the NDA and access the materials for this listing?

Inquire Now

https://quietlight.com/listings/18830374?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=18830374

 

Detailed Description.   Launched in October 2024, this SaaS business is a B2B

SaaS/FinTech platform combining invoicing (main product line), payments, and

e-signatures in one white-labeled product built specifically for marketing

agencies. It gives agency owners and finance leads agency-specific billing

workflows, contract templates, and the lowest payment processing fees in its

category.

Customers can avoid paying 3% processor fees and pay a flat $100 per month. They

save more in fees than the subscription costs, and that gap grows with volume.

Ideal customers are billing $10K-plus per month.

The business is has been bootstrapped. Over the trailing 12 months, it generated

roughly $43K in revenue and about $33K in seller's discretionary earnings

(margins of ~77%). Current MRR is $3,350 across 40 paying customers on a single

$100-per-month tier (some are grandfathered in on a discounted plan). Customers

are 95% US and 5% Canada.

The codebase was rebuilt from the ground up 6 months ago (Python/Django and

TypeScript/React), so the platform is modern, stable, and scalable with minimal

technical debt.

The founder is migrating the processing to Sola (Fiserv, a payment processor)

and is expected to be completed in 30 days. It cuts variable processing costs by

roughly 90%, doubles processing residuals, and removes a $500-per-month legacy

fee.

Pricing has stayed at one tier since December 2024, leaving room for tiered

plans. The founder is working on new bookkeeping-firm referral partnerships with

several firms in discussion. The product road map items already requested by

customers (i.e., payment links, an open API, an MCP/AI connection, and

credit-card surcharging) are being added shortly to the platform and could widen

customer fit.

The seller is exiting to prioritize family stability after more than 3.5 years

as a full-time founder. He offers up to 80 hours of transition support over 60

days and estimates roughly 95% of daily operations could be handed to a virtual

assistant.  

 

 

Request an info packet.   The average Quiet Light listing receives 3 offers,

often within days of listing. Inquire now to get a leg up on other buyers.  

Inquire Now

https://quietlight.com/listings/18830374?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=18830374

  No obligation or financial commitment.

Key Benefits.  

Profitable and Bootstrapped   The business has generated ~$33K in TTM SDE with

~77% margins.

Built-In Fee Savings For Customers   The flat $100-per-month pricing often saves

agencies more in processing fees than they pay.

Modern, Stable Tech   With the codebase rebuilt six months ago on Python/Django

and React, there is minimal technical debt.

Pricing Optionality   Offering only one tier since December 2024 leaves room for

higher-value plans.

Product-Led Growth Ready   A self-serve signup flow is nearly built for reducing

sales-led friction.

Delegable Operations   Approximately 95% of daily work can be handed off to a

virtual assistant, and 80 hours of training are included.
